chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Sahl ibn Zyad, who said: Amr ibn Uthman narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Talha al-Shami, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

Regarding the words of God, the Exalted: 'When they disregarded the warnings that had been given them,' he said: They were of three types: a group who accepted and informed others [so they were saved]; a group who accepted but did not inform others [so their arms were distorted]; and a group who did not accept and did not inform others [so they perished].

key_terms.فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ: When they disregarded the warnings that had been given them

ai.seo_question: What are the three groups of people described in the interpretation of the verse 'When they disregarded the warnings that had been given them'?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) elucidates the fate of the Children of Israel by categorizing them into three distinct groups based on their adherence to and transmission of divine commandments. This exegesis highlights the theological principle that mere acceptance without propagation leads to distortion, while total rejection results in destruction, a framework often applied to the broader community of believers.
